result.finding: The web module uses an embedded Apache Tomcat servlet container (Servlet API 4.0 / Java EE 8) via spring-boot-starter-web in Spring Boot 2.7.18. The application is packaged as a fat JAR (not WAR), so no external servlet container is required. The worker module has no servlet container — it is a standalone Spring Boot application. The code uses javax.servlet API (pre-Jakarta namespace), which is a migration blocker for Spring Boot 3.x (which requires jakarta.servlet).
evidence: web/pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-web (includes tomcat-embed-core, tomcat-embed-el, tomcat-embed-websocket via Spring Boot 2.7.18 BOM)
Default JAR packaging (no <packaging>war</packaging> in pom.xml) — embedded container, no external app server
web/WebMvcConfig.java: imports javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest and HttpServletResponse — Servlet 4.0 (Java EE 8) namespace
No web.xml found — annotation-based servlet configuration
worker/pom.xml: spring-boot-starter (no web, no servlet container)
values: Container: Embedded Apache Tomcat 9.0.x (via Spring Boot 2.7.18)
Spring Boot 3.x migration note: javax.servlet → jakarta.servlet namespace change required
